notes.title: Sime Returns is Officially Announced!
notes.content: [p]Sime Returns combines everything you loved from the [b]Sime Is Back[/b] trilogy into one cohesive, polished, and expanded adventure.[/p][p]What begins as a lighthearted island homecoming quickly spirals into a surreal odyssey filled with betrayal, Adriatic folklore, and a descent into the mysterious ruins of Atlantis.[/p][p][b]Wishlist Sime Returns on Steam:[/b] [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4002670/Sime_Returns/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thank you all for playing and supporting Sime over the years. Your feedback and encouragement made this next step possible![/p]

notes.title: New Update: Introduction Chapter Now Available!
notes.content:
This update adds a brand new Introduction Chapter, giving players a chance to experience the events that led up to Sime Is Back 18+
Based on the previous game, Sime Is Back 3D Old School, this short playable sequence offers a glimpse into the backstory.

If you’re new to the series or just want a quick refresh of the lore, this is a great place to start.

Thank you for playing and supporting the game!
